solvedBy: Kogoro Mouri (partially on his own, the rest via Conan)

summary.en: In a hotel where Kogoro and Conan have an appointment with Kogoro's client, they happen to meet one of Kogoro’s huge fan, Natsumi Sasakawa, whom her dad soon appears to give a proper introduction to Kogoro. Then Kogoro’s client, Ryota Tanno, arrives and begins to discuss with the detectives about the recent threat letter he received.
